authorization: 按照这个方案继续：版本化分布加权KV淘汰、独立校准及阶段门控
prefill_cost_proxy: For already observed block-aligned P, calibrate exact prompt length P+1; the native backend requires one uncached token. No future request suffix is used. This is a declared one-token proxy, not exact future cost.
hit_blocks: every integer from zero through the observed prefix block count

calibration.sample_order: seeded interleaving of prefix length per repeat and hit length within each prefix; each request materializes its full prefix again
calibration.fit: equal-weight mean of both fit repetitions at each grid point, then decreasing pool-adjacent-violators; no fastest-sample selection
calibration.validation: independent third repetition; global MAE <= 10% of mean validation prefill and MAE <= 50% of median positive fitted adjacent-block marginal; require positive median marginal
calibration.failure: retain rejected table and raw measurements; cost-aware policy is not enabled if validation fails

native_gate: 13 original physical/protocol/abort probes plus 5 real generations with explicitly synthetic crossing distributions to prove ranking-to-native-drop; synthetic scores make no predictor accuracy claim
resource_scope: Own GPU 5/6/7 only after idle verification; own CPU affinity is not reservation. Read-only model pages pinned in separate own process. No global cache/THP settings or interference with other tenants.
instrumentation_scope: Native prefill_ns excludes decode and Python control. Native/calibration only, no tools, no natural JCT claim. Record parent IO, faults, host/GPU identity and model residency; no ptrace during calibration.
natural_JCT_gate: Do not start natural JCT here. Prior controller 4KiB read remains unattributed. A subsequent version must trace parent/descendant I/O outside timing and freeze strict parent read_bytes and major-fault gates before any natural B/C or A/B/C/D crossover.
failure_rule: Stop on any token/physical/ownership/protocol/source/GPU-tenant/generation-bound violation, retain every reservation and failure; no replacement samples. Calibration validation failure rejects the table, not its evidence.
prior_failed_attempt: Original disk-backed model pin startup exceeded 60s; full SHA256 completed; zero generations; immutable failure and sealed zero-use ledgers retained.
version_change: Reuse identity-stable fully hashed model; bound initial model pin response at 1800s, later checks at 60s. Same generation/calibration/sample-order limits and acceptance criteria. Compare source plan SHA256 plus parsed frozen-plan equality; JSON whitespace is not a content change. Second setup failure also zero generations and preserved.
